description:
## Objective

Prove that the completed quality system satisfies the repository quality contract and the revised benchmark layout.

## Scope

Run the full offline quality matrix. Reconcile CI, Mix aliases, agent guidance, READMEs, manifests, component proof, coverage baselines, and quality reports with the final test tree. Keep provider and external service checks explicit and opt-in.

Do not change lib or refs. Do not weaken a threshold to make a failure pass.

## Acceptance criteria

- There is no tracked top-level bench folder or reference to one.
- All benchmark code and documents are under test/bench.
- Required offline CI runs unit, authoring, Covenant, property, fuzz, system, load, example, benchmark smoke, coverage, and architecture checks.
- Live provider and external service checks stay opt-in.
- All public components have complete proof or an allowed and specific not-applicable reason.
- Package and component coverage meet the objective thresholds.
- Covenant obligation coverage is 100 percent.
- The final quality report has no required finding.
- Documentation commands match Mix aliases and actual paths.
- The epic completion comment contains exact commands, counts, coverage, deferred cases, and final Git revision.

## Verification

Run mix format --check-formatted, mix compile --warnings-as-errors, mix test.ci, mix quality.coverage, mix quality.report, mix covenant.check, mix reach.check --arch --smells, and mix test.bench.

## Handoff

Record all commands and results. Do not close this task or the epic while a required check is failing or required evidence is missing.

comments.text: Final acceptance passed on clean main revision 71a1580e4e03f39d6c77c490a86ce54898859cf0. Exact checks passed: mix format --check-formatted; mix compile --warnings-as-errors; mix test.ci; mix quality.coverage; mix quality.report; mix covenant.check; mix reach.check --arch --smells; mix test.bench; mix quality; and focused CI/layout/component-proof reconciliation. Counts: unit and direct Covenant 3,337 passed/468 excluded; Covenant 323/323 obligations across 40 components; authoring 74; examples 260; property 55 with 3 properties/52 tests and 13 excluded; fuzz 13/55 excluded; system 5/7 excluded; load 3; peer 7/3,798 excluded; benchmark smoke 30. Coverage: package 93.1726% (16,390/17,591); all 40 components passed the 80% floor and regression rules; lowest was jido_ai.observability at 81.8372%; all ten suite contributions recorded. Final report: PASS, dirty=false, ten suites pass, zero findings, zero waivers. Static gate: blocking Credo found no issue; Dialyzer baseline skipped 26 known warnings with zero unused filters; ExDNA stayed within its 17-clone ceiling; Reach architecture passed and 276 existing smell findings remain advisory. No tracked or on-disk top-level bench tree exists, no stale local bench command remains, all benchmark assets and documents are under test/bench, and final reconciliation passed 15 tests. CI contains named required offline jobs plus coverage and architecture checks; live provider and external service jobs remain manual/opt-in. Deferred cases: live provider success was not run without an approved key; the MinIO live-host success path was not run on an unavailable host; Bedrock live coverage remains deferred for its recorded upstream issue. These are not required offline findings. No lib or refs change. Worktree clean. Not pushed.
